mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the floor over the tabs and folding them flat was worthwhile: the successive descriptions made the fastening process clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the turntable to the base was straightforward but less informative than the tab fastening; its description did not show much about how the parts connect.
